scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with reproducible finite consistency checks; numerical tests are not offered as proofs of the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional complex Bargmann–Fock space and five-parameter Gaussian kernels; uses the published boundedness/compactness characterization. The full earlier oscillator-semigroup literature might contain an equivalent formulation. Novelty is a best-knowledge assessment only; independent validation absent.
title: Weyl symmetry and flat approximation numbers for noncompact Gaussian Fock operators
